blocks.orig: In Zanzibar, you can go deep-sea fishing on a boat with professional anglers. The Indian Ocean is home to blue marlin, dorado, yellowfin tuna, kingfish and many more large species that make for an excellent fishing day. The local captain knows the area well and can tell you what fish can be found at a specific time of the year. Zanzibar’s deep turquoise waters, the blue skies, tropical temperatures and the waves lapping against the boat’s prow make this a perfect (half) day out.
blocks.html: Zanzibar is a place where you can head out deep-sea fishing aboard a boat with professional anglers. Blue marlin, dorado, yellowfin tuna, kingfish and many other large species live in the Indian Ocean, making for a great day of fishing. The local captain knows these waters well and can tell you which fish are around at a particular time of year. With Zanzibar’s deep turquoise sea, blue skies, tropical warmth and waves lapping at the bow, this is an ideal (half) day out.
